title: The Dress of Honor Is from Heavens
body:
Madad ya Sayyidee!
(Mawlana stands)
As-salaamu `alaykum `ala `ibaadillah. Hasbunallah, rabbunallah. Hasbunallah rabbunallah. Hasbunallah
rabbunallah. Hasbunallahu wa ni`ma 'l-wakeel... anta mawlana. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illaLlah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! alfu salaat, alfu salaam wa’l-aakhireen! Highest respect
and glory to most honored and glorified one in Divinely Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s) (du’a Arabic). Ya
Rabb! To follow enlightened road, direct road, for reaching Allah Almighty's heavenly dominions. And we are
saying a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem, bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem. We are asking from
the honor of the most honored one Sayyidina Muhammad (s), to follow enlightened road, the direct road for
reaching Allah Almighty’s heavenly dominions. (Mawlana sits.)
Just today, O our listeners, I lost my eyeglasses but today I found it. (Mawlana puts on eyeglasses.) And this
also making me to look down, not to look forward. Doesn’t matter. As-salaamu `alaykum to our respected
listeners, that you are giving a time for listening. You are not listening to me, no. I know nothing, I am but a
weak servant. What my master granting and ordering to me to address to you, it is only my mission. I am not

expecting from you any material aspect, no. What my Lord granted to me is more than enough, more than
enough. Why I am asking anything from creatures or from Mankind? What should they give to me? If the
Lord of Heavens asking to grant to me something, may some ones (…sound cut)…and they are bringing to me
mindly or bodily aspects as His commands.
O My listeners, I am not joking. We must take every event seriously. When not taking seriously we are losing,
here and Hereafter. O people, through my master, to whom masterhood of this world granted to him (s),
because there must be someone looking after this world from heavenly centers and to control. Longerly or
widerly (the master) must look. And he may do his mission through command of the Lord of Heavens. And
his Lord, Allah Almighty, ordering something. It is suitable that Allah is not giving a heavy burden on His
servants, but His orders are only so light and so easily and so useful. Every heavenly command is making
people to be strong ones, to carry heavenly orders and to fulfill it as much as possible. Therefore, if Allah
Almighty dressing on one person in this world, he may do everything according to commands of Allah
Almighty, fulfilling it.
As we are looking and seeing a huge aircraft carrier, one person commanding it and that gigantic carrier is
fulfilling it. That huge, gigantic carrier is running in that direction, which the small captain is ordering it.
That gigantic aircraft carrier is obeying to a man, and that man looks like a finger beside his bigness. Yes,
when Lord of Heavens giving an authority and dressing masterhood for this planet, it is enough. “Do!” He
says. “I am ready, O my Lord,” (that one answers). What He is asking to do, through His holy command, I
may move this planet in different directions; it is not difficult for me.

SubhaanAllah, sultaan Allah maa `adhama shaanak Ya Rabb! You are so great one, (there is) no measure
for Your Greatness, Ya Rabb, and that is what I am saying. What my master is sending to me according to
heavenly commands I must obey. I don't know anything, but if he is sending to me I may speak and my
speech is going to have an affect on the souls and their physical beings. If that person's intention is good, it
will bring good results and will give more heavenly support as well, as heavenly lights coming through his
heart. That light showing to that person from east to west from earth up to heavens, so powerful!
Biggest telescope is in America under command of one astronomer, moving, and every direction that it is
directed, showing this, this, this. What about holy ones’ position, whom they have been granted heavenly

powers to show people what it is right and what it is wrong? Therefore, we are in need of such a master.
Without masterhood, you can’t reach to anything. I am a simple person and I know nothing, but they are
ordering to me to address people. And I am never thinking if I can do that or not, because it is not my
capacity. You by your common knowledge can’t address to the whole of humanity. It is so difficult. But it is…
I am here as a translator only; what they are giving to me, I am translating. Therefore, I am not carrying any
burden, and I am not getting hamm (worry); I am not worrying about what I am saying today. But Shaytan
saying, “Oh shaykh, finished for you today. Finished what you know. Tomorrow finishing. Why you are
sitting and addressing people?” I am saying “Get out! Get out! I am only a tap, not pub.”
Same form, but so long distance. I am not pub, but I am a very humble tap. Even drops coming, it is enough.
One drop from them feeds the whole world. What I am saying, or what they are making me to speak, one
day’s speech may be enough for those who are thirsty for learning realities of this Creation, and I may give a
low dosage. I am sitting here as a person sitting through any gathering and speaking. Anyone who likes to
speak may speak. I may say to His Holiness the Pope, “You may speak.” I may say Chief Rabbi, “You may
speak.” I may say to Dalai Lama, “Come, address people daily without reading books. What it is inside, say to
people. What you are knowing teach to people, make them understand.” Because people are asking for
someone to teach them something that they are thirsty for. I am saying “thirsty,” and I am remembering that
I must drink a little bit because I am thirsty. (Mawlana sips water.) Bismillah, shukr alhamdulillah!
Therefore my listeners, as-salaamu `alaykum! If you don’t like what I am saying, come and you may speak. I
am listening. I am not getting angry. I don’t like people who are seeking truth to object and refuse what I am
saying, because my heart is connected with heavenly masters’ hearts!
As-salaamu `alaykum, O our listeners! Yes, as Allah Almighty is asking, you must listen and you must try to
be intelligent ones. People on this world going to be into two classes. One class of mankind are intelligent
ones, but very few, and second class are idiot ones - countless, countless idiot ones!! Whom are not asking for
truth, they are all idiot ones! But intelligent ones, they are clever ones, enlightened ones. But mostly people
their identity is idiot ones. There is a place on your identity card for identity, it is written, “engineer,” or
“captain,” or “businessman,” or “Minister of Parliament (MP),” or WC member (joke). When you are looking
at people, they should find this, such an identity point to give a description for that one. Now people,
intelligent ones and idiot ones, means “stupid ones,” and stupid ones means they are rubbish ones! Look

what is good for you; which side going to give you an honor here and Hereafter? So easy. Look at yourself. If
you are intelligent, you must hear, you must listen to heavenly addressings. And intelligent ones, looking,
hearing, and walking. But stupid ones, or idiot ones, they never taking any care. Their importance is only to
eat and drink, and to ride on their female ones and nothing else. They are not thinking anything except what
they are eating or enjoying, or to enjoy through sexual actions. They are on the level of animals, not same
level, but their levels coming lower. Animals’ level is going to be higher than them, yes.
Therefore, O our listeners, you are welcome here to make a show from myself. But I am not trying to show
people something that gives me for some days or for some months a pleasure, no. Therefore, we must be
sincere. Sincerity is most acceptable characteristic from servants. Sincere servants, they should reach high
stations. Whom they are not sincere, they are munaafiq, hypocrites who should be thrown down.
Welcome to you! You think that if you are giving a short time for listening such a thing and you may say,
“Doesn’t matter, we know what he is saying.” Yes, but this saying is more strong, more powerful, that you are
running after it. From this you can take a heavenly respect and honor by giving a short time for listening. The
Lord of Heavens ordering angels, “Dress them in the Dress of Honor.” The Dress of Honor is not the Marks &
Spencer shirts, trousers and jackets (from famous UK dept. store). No, it is not dress of honor.
O people! Try to dress in the Dress of Honor. Mankind in this world always following new fashions. For
what? Because they think if they are using new fashion clothes, that clothes giving them an honor, that it is
Dress of Honor. “Honor” as you understand in this world is among people looking to your clothes and saying,
“Oh, that is such an honored one.” Particularly high-ranked person, they are using (a worldly) dress of honor.
If they have been granted from kings or queens or sultans, they are thinking that it is giving them honor on
their clothes. But we are trying to make people understand that the real Dress of Honor, you can’t find it on
Earth, but it is coming from heavens. Is it true or not, O Your Holiness, Pope? Is it not true what we are
saying, O Chief Rabbi? What do you think? They are saying “Yes, yes sir.” No one can refuse (what I am
saying), that Dress of Honor is not coming from Earth. Holy people know the Dress of Honor coming from
heavens, not from Earth.
I was, once upon a time, first traveling to London. Someone took me to the Tower Castle, where they are
showing so many things that belongs to passed-away kings and queens as their crown and their royal clothes.

And I was standing and looking at one of the tour guides, asking him, “You are saying this belongs to Her
Majesty, Queen Victoria, and this crown belongs to His Majesty King George V.” I reached to his reign and
also his Silver Jubilee. I was an elementary school student and always first in my class, and granted to me was
a medal for the occasion of the Silver Jubilee of late King George V, may Allah (swt) from His endless oceans
give them.
We are asking for everyone happiness. We are asking for everyone through this life and after this life for
eternal life, to be happy, to reach peace, and to reach endless enjoyments and lights in their Lord’s Divinely
or heavenly levels! Yes! O people, give a time (to listen to these live broadcasts) and don’t run away! Today we
learned something. It is enough, may be enough, but when you are planting a plant you must give water. You
must also try to water your minds, your understandings, and your feelings.
O people, it is not an ordinary words what I am saying, and I am requiring from the chiefs of nations and the
chiefs of holy ones, to address people daily. But they are addressing. Don’t think the Lord of Heavens closing
down for them if they are addressing every day!
May Allah (swt) forgive me and thank you, my listeners! I am not asking for any rank, for any honor in this
life, no. I am asking honor for heavenly levels of the Lord of Heavens. May Allah (swt) forgive me and you,
and make us to live according to His holy commands, (then we will be in) endless satisfaction and honor and
pleasure and enjoyment and lights forever! Allah (swt) is The Great, and His most beloved one is most
praised, and His holy prophets are on their ranks and glorifying Him! Ameen.
Fatihah.
44 minutes Sayyidee.
(Mawlana smiles and sings)
Dome dome dome dome 5x
Let us to listen and let us to hear
heavenly singing of my Lord's angels,
here and Hereafter.

O my Lord, whole praising for You,
whole glory for You only.
Give us Your pleasure,
give us honor from Your generosity.
O our Lord, and forgive us!
Fatihah.
